_provenance: Reconstructed by hand from video frames t029.5–t041 (media/keyframes/t29_5.jpg … t41.jpg) and user screenshots. Values are from ONE moment of one run. Keys shown in order seen. '…' = scrolled past / not legible. Keys prefixed _ are annotations, not part of the original.
_section_static_context: Top of report (scrolled past at t029). Appears to be a static 'rules of the world' block. Parent key name not visible.

shotgun.one_liner: devastating up close, pellets scatter with distance

player_physics.acceleration: reaches max speed in ~1.1 seconds from standstill

measurement_context.distance_unit: Doom map unit; not inches, feet, meters, or miles. The player's body is 32 units wide.

distance_bands.contact: under 64 map units; immediate melee range
distance_bands.close: 64 to under 256; nearby dangerous engagement range
distance_bands.medium: 256 to under 768; ranged engagement and meaningful travel distance
distance_bands.far: 768 or more; distant and substantial travel required

measurement_context.vertical_aim: automatic when the target is in view; only horizontal bearing matters then. A shot stops on the first solid thing in front of the muzzle — a target on higher or lower ground that is out of sight cannot be hit until you back off far enough to see it

time.control_rate: decisions update every ~4 ticks (~0.1 seconds); controls persist continuously between decisions

measurement_context.controls: aiming, movement, and the trigger operate simultaneously
measurement_context.projectile_prediction: closest approach assumes the player stays at the current position; moving changes it
